scope: Selected product-label references and exact generic partner names; not a complete clinical interaction checker or coadministration assessment.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Revlimid / lenalidomide product label
source.note: The product label identifies Revlimid as a lenalidomide product.

references.title: Digoxin exposure
references.basis: The label reports increased digoxin exposure with lenalidomide in the studied setting and describes periodic digoxin-level monitoring.

references.title: Warfarin study and monitoring context
references.basis: The studied combination did not alter lenalidomide or warfarin pharmacokinetics. The label retains PT/INR monitoring for multiple-myeloma patients taking warfarin and notes that the dexamethasone–warfarin interaction is unknown.

references.title: Therapies that can increase thrombosis risk
references.basis: The label describes caution with erythropoietic agents and other thrombosis-promoting therapies, including estrogen-containing therapies. These classes are not expanded into individual drug matches.

entries.reference_product: Velcade injection reference; intravenous or subcutaneous labeling

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Velcade / bortezomib product label
source.note: The product label identifies Velcade as a bortezomib product.

references.title: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor example
references.basis: The label describes increased bortezomib exposure with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and identifies ketoconazole as the studied example; toxicity monitoring is discussed. Other class members are not inferred.

references.title: Strong CYP3A4 inducer example
references.basis: The label describes decreased bortezomib exposure with strong CYP3A4 inducers and advises avoiding that combination; rifampin is the studied example. Other class members are not inferred.

references.title: Dexamethasone studied context
references.basis: The label reports no clinically significant interaction with dexamethasone in the studied setting. This finding does not establish general regimen compatibility or safety.

references.title: Omeprazole studied context
references.basis: The label reports no clinically significant interaction with omeprazole in the studied setting. This finding does not establish general regimen compatibility or safety.

entries.reference_product: Darzalex intravenous injection reference; not Darzalex Faspro

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Darzalex / daratumumab product label
source.note: The product label identifies Darzalex as a daratumumab product.

references.title: Blood compatibility testing interference
references.basis: Daratumumab can interfere with indirect antiglobulin testing, including antibody screening and cross-matching. This is a laboratory-test reference, not a second-drug interaction match.

references.title: Electrophoresis and immunofixation interference
references.basis: The label describes possible interference with serum protein electrophoresis and immunofixation used to assess disease protein and response. No assay execution or observed interference is inferred from a trial name.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Pomalyst / pomalidomide product label
source.note: The product label identifies Pomalyst as a pomalidomide product.

references.title: Strong CYP1A2 inhibitor example: fluvoxamine
references.basis: The label reports increased pomalidomide exposure with fluvoxamine and advises avoiding strong CYP1A2 inhibitors. Product-specific management is described in the complete label.

references.title: Strong CYP1A2 inhibitor example: ciprofloxacin
references.basis: Ciprofloxacin is a named example in the label precaution about strong CYP1A2 inhibitors. This selected reference does not assert a ciprofloxacin-specific clinical interaction study.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Kyprolis / carfilzomib product label
source.note: The product label identifies Kyprolis as a carfilzomib product.

references.title: Midazolam studied context
references.basis: The label reports that carfilzomib did not affect midazolam pharmacokinetics in the clinical interaction study. This specific finding is not a general absence-of-interactions statement.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: HEMADY / dexamethasone product label
source.note: HEMADY identifies dexamethasone. This pinned historical reference does not establish the formulation or current marketing status of a trial intervention.

references.title: CYP3A4 exposure context
references.basis: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors can increase dexamethasone exposure; strong inducers can decrease it.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Cyclophosphamide injection product label
source.note: The product identifies cyclophosphamide. This intravenous reference does not establish a trial intervention’s formulation, route or current marketing status.

references.title: Protease inhibitor context
references.basis: Protease inhibitors may increase cytotoxic-metabolite concentrations; regimen-specific infection and neutropenia findings are described.

references.title: Anthracycline context
references.basis: The label identifies potential additive cardiac toxicity with anthracyclines.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Evomela / melphalan product label
source.note: Evomela identifies melphalan. This product reference does not establish trial formulation, route, treatment role or current marketing status.

entries.reference_product: Evomela intravenous reference; myeloma transplant conditioning

references.title: Cyclosporine sequence context
references.basis: Renal impairment was reported after intravenous melphalan followed by oral cyclosporine; formal interaction studies were not conducted.

source.publisher: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
source.title: Fludarabine phosphate injection product label
source.note: The label links the phosphate product to fludarabine-equivalent content. Name mapping does not equate doses, routes or active-metabolite exposure.

entries.reference_product: Fludarabine phosphate intravenous reference; B-cell CLL labeling

references.title: Pentostatin combination context
references.basis: The label warns against this combination because of severe and fatal pulmonary toxicity.
